title: Haim Eshed claims US astronauts and aliens in underground Mars bases

tellings.quote: In 2020, Him Eched, former head of Israel's defense ministry's space directorate, essentially the father of the Israeli space program, publicly claimed that American astronauts and alien representatives were operating on underground bases on Mars.

plain: In 2020, Haim Eshed, the former head of the space office in Israel's defense ministry and in effect the father of the Israeli space programme, publicly said that American astronauts and alien representatives were working together at underground bases on Mars. Michels relays the claim himself in an episode about a hacker who says he found NASA's secret space programme. If true, it would mean a hidden human presence on Mars alongside aliens.
